text: Callum Varga scored for Seabrook Town at 69 minutes, leveling the score at 2-2 with a smart finish from 9 meters, assisted by Tariq Marlowe’s through ball [#1448] [#1446]. The goal came after a quick counter-attack started by Aiden Quinlan’s interception, involving three passes over 16 seconds that showed Seabrook’s wide and fast attacking style working well [#1442]. Before the goal, Seabrook had kept the pressure on with over half the ball and four shots, while Harbour City’s patient passing wasn’t enough to stop them.
